item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 25 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 25 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 10 September 2026(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(San Felipe, San Narciso, San Antonio, Subic, Castillejos, San Marcelino, Olongapo) and Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Morong).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Pampanga, Cavite, Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Zambales(Botolan, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan, Calaca, Mabini, Tingloy, Bauan, Taal, Santa Teresita, San Luis, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Laurel, Lemery, Talisay, Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Lipa, Cuenca, Alitagtag, San Jose, San Pascual), Nueva Ecija(San Antonio, Cabiao, San Isidro, Gapan, San Leonardo, Jaen, Zaragoza) and Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Alaminos, Calauan, Los Banos, Bay, Victoria, Pakil, Mabitac, Pangil, Santa Maria, Famy, Siniloan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan(Bagac, Orion, Pilar, Balanga, Abucay, Limay, Mariveles), Tarlac(Gerona, Santa Ignacia, Paniqui) and Quezon(General Nakar) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
